description: This file defines the CatalogItemOrdered class, a value object in the domain representing a snapshot of an ordered catalog item, including its ID, name, and picture URI. It includes a constructor with validation using Ardalis.GuardClauses and a private parameterless constructor for ORM purposes.

classes.name: CatalogItemOrdered
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of an ordered catalog item, ensuring its details do not change later, even if catalog details are updated.

methods.name: CatalogItemOrdered
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CatalogItemOrdered instance, validating inputs.

methods.name: CatalogItemOrdered (private)
methods.description: Parameterless constructor required for Entity Framework ORM.
